race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: MAHOLLIA was impressive when winning a Fontainebleau bumper and makes plenty of appeal on hurdles bow having since been recruited by Willie Mullins. Divaboriva sets a good standard amongst those with hurdling experience, though the drop back in trip isn't an obvious positive. Listed bumper winner Coole Cafe completes the shortlist. MAHOLLIA (FR) DIVABORIVA (IRE) COOLE CAFE (IRE)
